title: Bulleted List

illustrates.quote: Retain bullets whenever they are used in lists.

blocks.features: Five items, each with a small solid round bullet.

print.printFeatures: Bold heading above five bulleted items, all with the same solid round bullet, no sub-levels.

braille.notes: Each item's bullet is transcribed with the dot symbol '_4' (the 'Dot' transcriber-defined symbol from 8.6.2.a) in cell 1 followed by a space, then the item text; line 1 carries the heading, line 2 blank, line 8 blank closes the list.

resolution: braille.lines byte-identical between A and B. Heading level: same issue as sample-8-11 — B’s literal "5" contradicted its own braille.notes ("Line 1 is the centered heading"); measured directly from source .txt (line 6387) = 11 leading U+2800 blank cells, matching centring floor((40−17)/2)=11 exactly — level 1 (centred), not cell-5. Bullet list (dot bullet on every item, per 8.6.2.a) kept as A had it.
